subject.title: [Bug] Cron Job 使用错误的飞书账号发送消息 - 缺少 accountId 自动推断

question: When cron delivery omits `delivery.accountId`, should account resolution prefer the agent/channel binding over session-derived `lastAccountId`, or preserve the current session-account precedence?
rationale: Both choices affect credential and tenant boundaries: binding-first reduces stale session account drift, while session-first may preserve existing workflows that intentionally inherit the most recent account context.

options.title: Prefer Binding After Explicit Account
options.body: Keep explicit `delivery.accountId` first, then use a single unambiguous agent/channel binding before session-derived account state, failing closed when binding resolution is ambiguous.

options.title: Preserve Session Precedence
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that multi-account cron jobs must set `delivery.accountId` explicitly when session account inheritance is unsafe.

options.title: Add Explicit Policy Surface
options.body: Require a dedicated cron delivery account policy or migration before changing existing account precedence.

recommendation.title: Prefer Binding After Explicit Account
recommendation.body: Keep explicit `delivery.accountId` first, then use a single unambiguous agent/channel binding before session-derived account state, failing closed when binding resolution is ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is a maintainer-level security and compatibility decision, and steipete committed the merged binding-fallback behavior this decision would revise.
